text: The problem with the world is that the intelligent people are full of doubts, while the stupid ones are full of confidence.
author: Charles Bukowski

text: Real stupidity beats artificial intelligence every time.
author: Terry Pratchett

text: Information is power. But like all power, there are those who want to keep it for themselves.
author: Aaron Swartz

text: The future is already here – it's just not very evenly distributed.
author: William Gibson

text: Talk is cheap. Show me the code.
author: Linus Torvalds

text: The saddest aspect of life right now is that science gathers knowledge faster than society gathers wisdom.
author: Isaac Asimov

text: Free software is a matter of liberty, not price.
author: Richard Stallman

text: The important thing is not to stop questioning. Curiosity has its own reason for existing.
author: Albert Einstein

text: The trouble with having an open mind, of course, is that people will insist on coming along and trying to put things in it.
author: Terry Pratchett

text: When something is important enough, you do it even if the odds are not in your favor.
author: Elon Musk

text: Every good work of software starts by scratching a developer's personal itch.
author: Eric S. Raymond

text: The first principle is that you must not fool yourself – and you are the easiest person to fool.
author: Richard Feynman

text: Sharing knowledge is the most fundamental act of friendship. Because it is a way you can give something without losing something.
author: Richard Stallman
note: Commonly attributed; no primary source found.

text: The best way to predict the future is to invent it.
author: Alan Kay

text: The only thing that makes life possible is permanent, intolerable uncertainty; not knowing what comes next.
author: Ursula K. Le Guin

text: I love deadlines. I love the whooshing noise they make as they go by.
author: Douglas Adams
